description: Model per role, chosen on measured merit (quality per dollar on the Gate Keeper benchmark), not by default. Re-test with method@model arms whenever a new model ships; change a role only through the same qualification.

reviewer.why: 48/48 key issues, 7 false positives (plain reviewer 15); Opus 5.5 gave 6 at ~2.4x cost

repair.why: 6/6 fixtures first attempt; Opus 5.5 repairer showed no gain

adjudicator.why: Grades and gates: strongest available and never a model under test

learning.why: Lesson capture and shared-rule selection: low volume, judgement-heavy, errors spread to every tenant

triage.why: Haiku 5.5 missed 5-8/48 key issues reviewing alone; triage in front of the reviewer is untested
